request.system: You are a strict claim verifier. You only trust the catalog facts given to you.
request.user:
Verify every factual claim in the campaign is grounded in the catalog facts. Fail if any claim is unsupported, exaggerated, or contradicts the facts.
Rules (from reviewer overrides):
- ANY mention of an out-of-stock product (stock 0) fails, whether or not the copy prompts purchase — no editorial exception.
- Numeric spec claims (lumens, hours, capacity, ratings) must match the catalog exactly; doubling or inflating a spec fails.
- Transferring an attribute from another product, or upgrading 'water-resistant' to 'waterproof', is a fabricated claim and fails.
- A comparative or superlative claim ('brightest', 'longest-lasting', 'most X') is scoped to the product type named in the claim and checked against the comparison set below: it fails if a same-type peer beats the subject on the compared attribute. Vague puffery ('great gear', 'toughest', 'best ever') with no measurable attribute is acceptable.
Catalog facts:
NB-LMP-05 Northbay Beacon Headlamp: attributes={'lumens': 400, 'battery_life_hours': 40, 'charge_port': 'USB-C', 'weight_grams': 95, 'rechargeable': True} stock=210

Other products of the same type (comparison set for superlative/comparative claims):
NB-0020 Northbay Lumen Headlamp: attributes={'weight_grams': 115, 'lumens': 250, 'battery_life_hours': 60, 'waterproof_rating_ipx': 7, 'rechargeable': True, 'material': 'aluminum housing'} stock=144

Claims to verify:
- 400 lumens of output
- Up to 40 hours of runtime
- USB-C rechargeable
- 95 grams
- 20% off exclusive for VIP members
- Offer ends Sunday

Body: You've put in the miles. You know what a headlamp needs to do at 4 a.m. on a switchback or inside a wet tent at the end of a long day.

As one of our VIP members, you're getting exclusive early access to 20% off the Northbay Beacon Headlamp (NB-LMP-05) — and this offer closes Sunday.

Here's what the Beacon does:

• 400 lumens of output — enough to read the trail well ahead of your feet on a moonless night.
• Up to 40 hours of runtime — that's multiple nights out before you need a charge.
• USB-C rechargeable — one less cable to track down before a trip.
• 95 grams — light enough that you'll forget it's on your head.

It's a focused tool built for backpacking, camping, and pre-dawn starts. It is not built for technical diving or industrial work.

This 20% discount is exclusive to VIP members and expires Sunday. Use it on your next trip out.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.

response:
```json
{
  "reasoning": "All numeric specifications (400 lumens, 40 hours runtime, USB-C, 95 grams) match the catalog exactly; the product is in stock (210 units); no superlative claims are made that would require comparison against peers; discount terms and expiration are promotional language not contradicted by catalog facts; the disclaimer about diving/industrial use is reasonable scope-setting.",
  "evidence": [
    "NB-LMP-05 attributes: lumens=400 ✓",
    "NB-LMP-05 attributes: battery_life_hours=40 ✓",
    "NB-LMP-05 attributes: charge_port='USB-C' ✓",
    "NB-LMP-05 attributes: weight_grams=95 ✓",
    "NB-LMP-05 stock=210 (not out-of-stock) ✓",
    "No superlative claims ('brightest', 'longest-lasting') made ✓",
    "Discount percentage and expiration are promotional claims, not spec claims ✓",
    "No attribute transferred from NB-0020 or other products ✓"
  ],
  "score": 1.0,
  "verdict": "pass"
}
```
